title: Galaxie's Modpack
description: A comprehensive optimization suite for peak performance, seamlessly integrated with essential competitive PVP mods for an enhanced, latency-reduced experience. Stop lag, win fights.
body:
**Galaxie's Modpack** is a precision-engineered optimization suite designed for players who refuse to compromise on performance. Whether you are playing on a high-end gaming rig or a budget laptop, this pack focuses on maximizing your frame rate (FPS) and minimizing input latency to give you a competitive edge in every fight.

**⚡ Peak Performance**
We have integrated the industry-standard optimization mods, including **Sodium, Lithium**, and **FerriteCore**. These mods work together to rewrite Minecraft’s rendering engine and optimize server-side logic, ensuring a buttery-smooth experience even in crowded PVP lobbies or complex environments.

**⚔️ Competitive PVP Features**
Beyond just speed, this pack includes essential tools for the modern combatant:

- **Enhanced HUD:** Keep track of your armor durability and active status effects without cluttering your screen.

- **Visual Clarity:** Optimized brightness and particle settings to help you track opponents through the chaos.
 
- **Input Optimization:** Reduced "ghost swings" and improved mouse input response for precise hit detection.

**🛠️ Lightweight & Reliable**
Unlike bulky "all-in-one" packs, this modpack stays lightweight. We only include mods that serve a purpose—keeping your game stable, your frames high, and your focus on the win.
